oids.name: upsEBatteryTestStart
oids.description: This object specify the battery test type and initiate battery test. If battTestWithTime selected, the test time is refer to upsEBatteryTestSettingTime.

oids.description: The object specify the test time for battery test in seconds.

oids.name: upsEBatteryTestResult
oids.description: This object indicate the test result of battery.

oids.name: upsEBatteryTestStartTime
oids.description: The value of the time the test in progress was initiated, or, if no test is in progress, the time the previous test was initiated. If the value of upsETestBatteryTestResult is noTestsInitiated(6), ...

oids.name: upsEBatteryTestElapsedTime
oids.description: The amount of time in format hh:mm:ss, since the test in progress was initiated, or, if no test is in progress, the previous test took to complete. If the value of upsTestResultsSummary is idle(1),...

oids.description: The weekday or specaial day on which the UPS should start battery test.

oids.description: The time that the battery test will be initiated in hh:mm format.

oids.name: upsEBatteryTestScheduleType
oids.description: The type of battery test.

oids.name: upsEBatteryTestScheduleTestWithTime
oids.description: The battery time of setting time test in seconds.

oids.name: upsEBatteryTestScheduleSpecialDay
oids.description: The special day that the battery test will be initiated in dd/mm/yyyy format.

oids.name: upsEControlOutputOffDelay
oids.description: Setting this value to other than zero will cause the UPS output to turn off after the number of seconds.

oids.name: upsEControlOutputOnDelay
oids.description: Setting this value to other than zero will cause the UPS output to turn on after the number of seconds.

oids.name: upsEControlOutputOnOffControl
oids.description: upsEOutputOff ( 1 ) indicates the shutdown sequence, upsEOutputOffCancel ( 2 ) indicates cancel the shutdown sequence, upsESleep( 3 ) indicates shutdown UPS first, then switch on.

oids.name: upsEShutdownEventAction
oids.description: Status of the corresponding shutdown Event. When set to disable(), shutdown process will not start when corresponding event occured.

oids.name: upsEShutdownwarningPeriodTime
oids.description: The Delay in seconds after the occurance of the curresponding shutdown event, and warning message should be popped in this period.

oids.name: upsEShutdownWarningPeriodInterval
oids.description: The frequency of sending warning messages to the connected clients when the curresponding shutdown event occurs. The value is in units of seconds.

oids.name: upsEWeeklyScheduleShutdownDay
oids.description: the weekday on which upsE shoud shutdown

oids.name: upsEWeeklyScheduleShutdownTime
oids.description: The time that the process of shutting down the UPS will be initiated in hh:mm format.

oids.name: upsEWeeklyScheduleRestartDay
oids.description: the weekday on which the UPS should restart.

oids.name: upsEWeeklyScheduleRestartTime
oids.description: The time the UPS will restart in hh:mm format.

oids.name: upsESpecialDayScheduleShutdownDay
oids.description: The special day on which UPS should shutdown with the format of DD/MM/YYYY.

oids.name: upsESpecialDayScheduleShutdownTime
oids.description: The time that the process of shutting down the UPS will be initiated in hh:mm format.

oids.name: upsESpecialDayScheduleRestartDay
oids.description: The special day on which the UPS should restart with the format of DD/MM/YYYY.

oids.name: upsESpecialDayScheduleRestartTime
oids.description: The time the UPS will restart in hh:mm format.

oids.name: upsESystemMasterOffDelay
oids.description: The UPS output will shutdown after the indicated number of seconds, -1 indicate no action.

oids.name: upsESystemMasterOnDelay
oids.description: The UPS output will start on after the indicated number of seconds, -1 indicate no action.
